enrichment.core_claim: Megahertz scalp oscillation triplets disappear under propofol anesthesia and return on waking, proposed as a microtubule-based correlate of consciousness.
enrichment.ask_question: How closely did the megahertz signal track BIS values during induction and emergence?
enrichment.challenge_question: How was it established that the megahertz triplets come from brain microtubules rather than environmental or electrode artifacts?
